mutants.why: the BLOCKTRAILER's declared cb must EQUAL the BBT cb; inverting the guard rejects every byte-integral block (valid root PC block fails at open) and accepts a cb-mismatched one
the computed weak-CRC over the raw block must EQUAL the trailer dwCRC; inverting the guard fails every authentic block (open reads the root PC block and fails closed)
ComputeSig(offset,bid) must EQUAL the trailer wSig; inverting the guard fails every authentic block so open() cannot read the root PC
the trailer's own bid must EQUAL the BBT bid; inverting the guard fails every authentic block (open reads the root PC block and fails closed)

declared uncompressed_size == cb marks a STORED (uncompressed) 4k block returned verbatim; inverting the test decompresses a stored block (passthrough fixture fails) and passes a compressed one through raw (compressed fixture fails)
a footer uncompressed_size of 0 means the 4k block is not compressed and is returned verbatim; removing that guard drives qUncompress over a stored (non-zlib) block and fails it closed

an inflated block is accepted only when its length EQUALS the footer's declared uncompressed_size; inverting the guard fails the valid compressed block (its sizes match) so the inflate fixture cannot open

disabling the exact-size invariant lets a stream whose inflated length differs from the declared uncompressed_size through; the size-mismatch fixture (declared = inflated+5) then opens instead of failing closed. Validates that fail-close test is non-vacuous

a failed qUncompress returns an empty buffer; suppressing the isEmpty fail-close (size() < 0 is never true for a signed qsizetype) only defers rejection to the downstream exact-size check (0 != a nonzero declared uncompressed_size), which fails the bad-zlib block closed identically. The emitted result is identical for every input
